title: Why Port Cranes Move in That Strange Hesitant Rhythm

scenes.text: Watch a container crane at any port, and the movement looks oddly hesitant.
It rushes, then eases, then creeps the last few metres.
It looks like an operator being far too careful.
It is actually the crane fighting physics.
A container hanging from cables is a pendulum weighing thirty tons.
Move too fast and the box keeps swinging long after the crane stops.
So the crane accelerates and brakes in a pattern timed to cancel the swing.
Done correctly, the container arrives already perfectly still.
That hesitation is not caution. It is the fastest possible way to move it.
